notes:
Account summary: medium-large regional EHR integrator + operator for several specialist clinics. Looking for a secure, high-quality RAG stack to power clinician search, chart summarization and disposition suggestions. Primary concerns: PHI must not cross tenant boundaries, strict access logging and retention, and observable reranking behavior for audits.

Requirements (high level):
- Workloads: dense embeddings for ~12-18M clinical notes, reranking for top-k candidate refinement (hybrid ANN -> re-rank with cross-encoder or distilled model).
- Indexing scale: initial POC 3M notes (avg 1.2KB/doc), target production ~12M notes with 10% daily delta ingestion. Expect ~200k queries/day after growth.
- Latency SLOs: vector lookup + top-100 candidate generation < 120ms p95; rerank (cross-encoder) end-to-end < 350ms p95 for clinician-facing UI. Background summarization jobs can be higher.
- Cost sensitivity: target amortized cost per interactive query < $0.06 (embeddings + vector search + re-rank). Cost vs. quality tradeoffs acceptable if documented.
- Models: prefer open-models or customer-provided artifacts. Interested in FP16/quantized options for cost. Must support deterministic rerank logs for audits.
- Routing/fallback: primary region US-EAST, fallback to US-WEST; must support private routing and automatic fallback to smaller quantized model if dedicated capacity constrained.
- Security: strict BAA requirements, customer-managed KMS/HSM, VPC peering (no public endpoints), immutable audit logs, SSO (SAML + SCIM), per-request provenance metadata retention (7+ years for audit).
